survived.why: equivalent since H37 (d30d4e6): the defect blanks the apply link in card_facts, which now only feeds the copy comparison; the card shows the record's apply link in its record section (record_items, guarded by the H37 defects on a named or unnamed key), and a copy's differing apply link by the generic line, both values whole, so every surface shows the same values; survives the whole suite at 2be781c (stage 2); kept for a decision, not retired (a re-anchor onto record_items would test the card's own line)

note: the tool records each defect's verdict (CAUGHT when the planted copy's run fails), not the failing tests' names; stage 2 settles a stage-1 survivor; the round's commits each ran their own new and re-anchored defects at the commit, every one caught
